{{Top|leg}}
'''Sinthenol''' was a type of drug released during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It prevented potent [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohols]] from having a long-lasting effect on the [[Brain/Legends|brain]], and it could also be used as a treatment for [[Hangover/Legends|hangovers]].<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Jos Vondar]] began using them during his stint in the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Units]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]].<ref name="MedStar II" />
